tables.labor_extension_receipts: CREATE TABLE `labor_extension_receipts` (`id` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,`version` varchar(32) NOT NULL,`plan_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`reference` varchar(100) NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.labor_expense_allocations: CREATE TABLE `labor_expense_allocations` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`expense_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`source_batch_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`source_movement_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`employee_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`employee_snapshot` longtext NOT NULL,`source_date` date NOT NULL,`date` date NOT NULL,`amount` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,`source_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`batch_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`movement_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`reference` varchar(150) NOT NULL,`reason` varchar(500) NOT NULL,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `h1c_expense_once` (`expense_id`),UNIQUE KEY `h1c_batch_once` (`source_batch_id`),UNIQUE KEY `h1c_movement_once` (`source_movement_id`),CONSTRAINT `h1c_alloc_expense_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`expense_id`) REFERENCES `v1_documents` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `h1c_alloc_batch_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`source_batch_id`) REFERENCES `money_batches` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `h1c_alloc_movement_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`source_movement_id`) REFERENCES `money_movements` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `h1c_alloc_employee_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employees` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `h1c_alloc_actor_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `h1c_alloc_json` CHECK (json_valid(`employee_snapshot`)),CONSTRAINT `h1c_alloc_amount` CHECK (`amount`>0),CONSTRAINT `h1c_alloc_date` CHECK (`date`>=`source_date`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.stock_initializations: CREATE TABLE `stock_initializations` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`item_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`production_document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`opening_document_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`opening_date` date NOT NULL,`production_date` date NOT NULL,`opening_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`production_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`approved` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `h1c_initial_item_once` (`item_id`),UNIQUE KEY `h1c_initial_opening_once` (`opening_document_id`),CONSTRAINT `h1c_initial_item_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`item_id`) REFERENCES `v1_items` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `h1c_initial_production_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`production_document_id`) REFERENCES `v1_documents` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `h1c_initial_opening_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`opening_document_id`) REFERENCES `v1_documents` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `h1c_initial_actor_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`),CONSTRAINT `h1c_initial_approved` CHECK (`approved`=1),CONSTRAINT `h1c_initial_dates` CHECK (`opening_date`<=`production_date`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
tables.labor_extension_audit: CREATE TABLE `labor_extension_audit` (`id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,`entry_type` enum('EXPENSE_ALLOCATION','STOCK_INITIALIZATION') NOT NULL,`entry_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`payload_hash` char(64) NOT NULL,`actor_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,`created_at` datetime(6) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY (`id`),UNIQUE KEY `h1c_audit_once` (`entry_type`,`entry_id`),CONSTRAINT `h1c_audit_actor_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`actor_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
